title: NOT cotton as advertised
text: NOT cotton as advertised. Despite the description, I don't believe these sheets are ”100% cotton.” For one thing, the tags DO NOT claim cotton; in fact, the tags don't claim any content at all, just washing instructions. The sheets are soft, yes, but also very thin and delicate as the typical microfiber sheets so popular these days, which is what I believe they are. Were my intent to buy microfiber, the cost is about right. I should've known ”100% cotton” wouldn't be available at this price - you get what you pay for.
